description: Use before booking meetings, shipping deadlines or marketplace cut-offs: given a country and a date, returns isHoliday true/false, the matching holiday record(s) if any, and the next public holiday on or after that date in the same country (looks ahead into the following year if needed). Public calendar data only. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
name: holiday_check
title: ScrapeMole Pulse: FX rates (ECB), currency conversion, time zones, weather (global + official US NWS forecasts and alerts), Hacker News, public holidays and geocoding for AI agents: Is this date a public holiday?
